# Cricket Wicket — International Cricket

An independent international cricket archive at https://cricket.rkjat.in/.
IPL has a separate site: https://crickrida.rkjat.in/.

## International archive
- /international/: search and filter matches by team, format, gender and year.
- /international/?match=ID: both teams' innings, scorecards and playing XIs.
- /players/: searchable profiles and player comparisons.
- /international/#coverage: provenance, source dates and missing coverage.
- /data/manifest.json: current source list and archive counts.

All available public Cricsheet Test, ODI and T20I files for men and women were imported. This is NOT complete cricket history, live scoring, fixtures, current rankings or news. Use the manifest for the date range. Player profiles and comparisons default to independent career-record snapshots. The ball-data switch shows archive aggregates. Never add these layers together. Missing fields remain null. Super overs are excluded from player aggregates. Source coverage has historical gaps and withheld Afghanistan matches.

Career provenance and scope completion: /data/career_manifest.json. Historical results: /data/historical_manifest.json. Result-only matches have no local innings scorecard and are labeled.

## Legacy India hub
/overview/ preserves the original India archive. /official/ contains separately dated, curated career snapshots. These have not been independently reverified by the international import and must not be described as current official totals.

## Sources
https://cricsheet.org/register/ — stable player identity links.
https://cricsheet.org/downloads/ — international source data.
Independent site, not affiliated with ICC or BCCI.
